data.title: Bitcoin Bounces Off Its Lowest Point In A Month, But Charles Schwab’s Adam Lynch Warns A Midterms Risk
data.description: Bitcoin (BTC) rebounded from its lowest point in nearly a month on Saturday, but Charles Schwab’s (SCHW) Adam Lynch warned that midterms could “grind [crypto industry] to a halt”.Lynch, Director of Equity Research at the Schwab Center for Financial Research, made the comments in an interview with S…
